name: User complains about slow response to IT ticket
goal: Check bot's response to complaints about IT ticket delays.
constraints: Bot should provide status update and set expectations.

phases.description: User asks for the status of their IT ticket.
User complains about the slow response (e.g., 'Why is this taking so long?').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the delay, apologizes, and provides an updated ETA if possible.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
